candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Amber Latvijas Balzams reported a pronounced deterioration in its financial performance during the first quarter of 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Net turnover declined by 29.6% to EUR 11.1 million compared with the same period last year, while total sales volumes fell by 36.1% to 517,600 nine-liter cases.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: This contraction in commercial activity was accompanied by a sharp erosion in profitability.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Gross profit dropped by 66.5% to EUR 1.2 million, primarily due to unfavorable shifts in product mix and adjustments to pricing methodologies, which overshadowed partial cost-reduction efforts.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Consequently, the company recorded an operating loss of EUR 1.6 million, reversing an operating profit of EUR 0.6 million in the prior-year quarter and pushing the operating margin into negative territory at minus 14.5 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The net result similarly deteriorated, showing a quarterly loss of EUR 1.4 million against a profit of EUR 0.9 million previously.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Management noted that the high comparison base in 2025, which benefited from a contractual revenue adjustment, further amplified the year-over-year decline.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The deterioration in earnings and cash generation was driven by a combination of external shocks and structural challenges.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: A major catalyst was the initiation of U.S. bankruptcy proceedings under Chapter 11 by the affiliated Stoli Group entity in January 2026, resulting in a complete loss of operational control over what had been the company’s largest customer.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: This event severely disrupted collections and strained working capital.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Compounding these pressures were geopolitical repercussions, including aggressive regulatory actions by Russian authorities that culminated in the confiscation of a key distilling asset, alongside a broader global downturn in the spirits sector characterized by weakening consumer demand and distribution channel inventory corrections.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: These factors collectively triggered acute liquidity constraints, leading to delayed excise tax payments and the freezing of corporate bank accounts by state revenue authorities.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: To preserve business continuity and safeguard creditor interests, the company successfully petitioned the Riga City Court to initiate legal protection proceedings on 5 February 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: This restructuring framework is currently enabling management to negotiate a formal liability resolution plan with a submission deadline of 5 October 2026, while maintaining essential production activities and fulfilling ongoing tax obligations, having remitted EUR 8.4 million to the state budget during the quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: The principal shareholder concurrently entered judicial reorganization proceedings in Luxembourg, benefiting from a court-granted moratorium that temporarily suspends debt enforcement until late August 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Despite the severe operational and financial headwinds, the company maintains a positive net current asset position exceeding EUR 82.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Management remains focused on implementing production efficiency upgrades, comprehensive cost optimization, and internal governance enhancements to stabilize the balance sheet and restore sustainable profitability once the restructuring processes conclude.
